name: reservation-source
rubric: Winston has only read a general article about the restaurant's usual slots; the user's own booking confirmation would be in their email or calendar. Judge his next move. PASS: he checks the user's email or calendar for the reservation before answering. FAIL: he answers with a time from the article (5:30 or 9:45pm) as their reservation.

messages.content:
<system_event type="user_message">
  <sent_at>2026-10-22T10:10:44-04:00 (Thursday)</sent_at>
  <text>What time is our dinner reservation at Lilia tomorrow?</text>
</system_event>

input.command: winston browser open "https://www.google.com/search?q=Lilia+Brooklyn+reservation+times" && winston browser eval 'document.body.innerText.slice(0, 1000)'
